issues.title: Keep the tone professional

issues.title: Use suitable benefit descriptions
issues.explanation: subjective wording: suitable; no testable condition was found; no positive or negative example is attached
issues.suggestion: Use clearly specified and evidence-backed benefit descriptions on product pages. Use only product benefits supported by an active approved fact; state the measured value, unit, and evidence period, and do not imply a medical outcome or guaranteed result.

issues.title: Substantiation for factual claims
issues.explanation: no positive or negative example is attached
issues.suggestion: Factual, measurable, comparative or performance claims must have a traceable approved source. If no source is found, request human review; do not infer that the claim is false. Use only product benefits supported by an active approved fact; state the measured value, unit, and evidence period, and do not imply a medical outcome or guaranteed result.

issues.title: Superlatives require proof
issues.explanation: no positive or negative example is attached

issues.title: Disclaimer cannot cure misleading main claim
issues.explanation: no positive or negative example is attached
issues.suggestion: A disclaimer must not contradict or attempt to cure a misleading main claim. Flag absolute promises alongside disclaimer language for human review. Use only product benefits supported by an active approved fact; state the measured value, unit, and evidence period, and do not imply a medical outcome or guaranteed result.

issues.title: Paid or gifted disclosure
issues.explanation: no positive or negative example is attached
issues.suggestion: Paid or gifted creator content must use a clear disclosure such as #ad or Paid partnership, subject to current platform guidance. issues.title: Restricted cure and guaranteed-result wording
issues.explanation: no positive or negative example is attached
issues.suggestion: Cure or guaranteed-result wording for health and skin products must be routed for human/legal review. This is not a legal determination. issues.title: AI-generated media declaration
